  • High comfort level with multinational financial services organizations

Regular

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering(AI Platform Programme Manager )

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：57003

Location: GZ/XA

Principal Responsibilities

  • Act as Programme Manager for the Group AI Platform by defining strategy, developing plans, tracking progress, and driving execution of platform-wide objectives across multiple teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement through a data-driven approach, using insights to strengthen delivery performance and operational outcomes.
  • Engage and communicate with global stakeholders to align priorities and ensure successful delivery.
  • Resolve issues and remove blockers to keep delivery on track and enable successful outcomes.
  • Provide consistent programme reporting on milestones, RAID items, and financials where applicable, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and required decisions.
  • Embed high-performing ways of working, including Agile delivery, clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and strong controls aligned to a regulated environment.
  • Coach and influence leaders and teams to strengthen execution discipline, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; 10+ years of programme / project management experience, with strategy management experience preferred.
  • Extensive experience of leading complex, cross functional technology initiatives across global teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy into executable roadmaps with measurable outcomes, drive delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to provide crisp executive updates, develop well-structured materials, and facilitate effective decision-making.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks and experience managing delivery using Agile ways of working.
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and influence diverse teams, building alignment across competing priorities.
  • Experience of managing AI/ML solutions or platforms delivery is preferred, along with a passion for AI/ML and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.

/51/LP/WX

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations

People and Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
  • Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
  • Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
  • Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
  • Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
  • Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
  • Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
  • Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

  • Software Engineering
  • Software Development
  • Application Design
  • Architecture

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Recruitment Assessments

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team

Trade Settlement & Confirmations Operations (TSCO) provides operational support to various desks within GEM and GFFX business including Corporate Banking, covering multiple products mainly Foreign Exchange, Precious Metals, Fixed Income, Money Market and Derivatives.

Primary functions performed range from trade processing, settlements, confirmations, reconciliations and reporting. TSCO also works closely with various offshore operational teams who forms part of the integral process supporting GEM/GFFX business.

What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
  • 20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
  • A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
  • On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
  • Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members


Your Key Responsibilities

Be responsible for the daily operation covering FX, MM product including treasury support etc. Standardize related product’s KOD/SOPs, optimize front to back collaboration; coordinate front to back workflows, coordinate with compliance, finance and IT to resolve issues efficiently; ensure full compliance with regulatory rules and internal risk framework; support derivatives margin management under UMR requirement etc.

Trade Settlement and Confirmation Management

  • Take leadership and be responsible for foreign exchange (FX) and money market (MM) daily processing.
  • Liaise and follow-up with Front Office on booking and/or settlement issue and ensure timely and accurate settlement of transactions.
  • Ensure daily processing are in compliant with internal control policies, procedures and standards as well as external regulatory requirements.
  • Close monitoring and effective management of trade confirmations to reduce outstanding aged items.


Regulatory Reporting

  • Prepare, compile, validate and submit regulatory reports in a timely manner.
  • Perform quality control checks to ensure reporting accuracy and completeness
  • Develop report automation and perform comprehensive periodic report review and validation
  • Regulators face off if needed


Process Optimization and Risk Control

  • Identify operational inefficiencies and propose automation/streamlining solutions.
  • Maintain and update operational manuals/procedures to reflect current practices


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Liaise with Front Office, Compliance, Legal, to address trade exceptions, client queries or regulatory related queries
  • Support Strategic projects and/or ad-hoc initiatives


Control related

  • Conduct control self-assessment for both processes or regulatory reports, KOD and checklist design and implementation
  • Where necessary, review operational workflow to stay compliant with internal policies and local regulations


Your Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business or related fields degree in Finance, Business or related field
  • Above 10 years’ work experience in investment banking or corporate banking roles and possess relevant product and regulatory knowledge
  • Bilingual in both written and spoken English and Mandarin
  • Proficient with MS Office applications
  • Ability to multi-task and work in dynamic environment
  • Demonstrate pro-activeness, self-disciplined, self-motivated with ability to work independently and effectively under pressure
  • Control-focused and ability to multi-task and prioritise work in fast-paced environment
  • Committed and reliable with a strong sense of teamwork
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


How We’ll Support You

  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • Training and development to help you excel in your career


About Us And Our Teams

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank & Diversity

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Job Summary

Drives relevant targets across team, and ensuring team members carry out maintenance of Limits and Pre-processing activities as per the laid down guidelines, Ensures that the team works collaboratively to deliver excellent client service, getting clients to the point of ready-to-transact as quickly as possible, and to within agreed service level agreements including turnaround times, productivity, and quality

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

Targeted Improvements

  • Engage a wide range of internal stakeholders for discussion in order to streamline processes and implement changes
  • Deliver excellent service against agreed service standards, delivery standards, and minimal error rates as appropriate
  • Make significant contribution to Credit Transformation Initiatives related to Fit For Growth (FFG) programme

For Grade 6 & 5B – in addition to all the above

  • Play a lead role in adoption of Ways of Working within the teams
  • Manage / Contribute to Change & Transformation initiatives for targeted improvements

Automation and Streamlining

  • Monitor the efficiency, effectiveness and quality of the operations from time to time and provide corresponding actions for improvement with respect to the changing business or customer needs
  • Drive continuous improvement of the operational efficiency and effectiveness of processes to increase the consistency of systems and processes
  • Drive adoption by the team, of the latest tools and techniques to improve performance

Business

  • Liaise with business units, other supporting operations and external business partners when necessary to capture business opportunities in a timely and effective way
  • Supporting various stakeholders on regulatory and audit requests
  • Act as a Relationship Manager for the respective in country & Group Client Management
  • Maintain good working relationships with the various Business Units, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations community
  • Undertake ad-hoc duties and when delegated by Line Manager and Country Head of Client Management
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and work closely with management to implement the change

Processes

General

  • Deliver quality, risk management, efficiency and effectiveness as per agreed standards & metrics
  • Drives relevant targets across team. Ensures that the team works collaboratively to deliver excellent client service, getting clients to the point of ready-to-transact as quickly as possible, and to within agreed service level agreements including turnaround times, productivity, and quality
  • Ensure work performed by team is error free with no operating losses and adheres to first time-right principles. Contribute to the teams’ BAU productivity at the highest standards, ensuring minimal rework across the team within all processes managed.
  • Manages document inventory, ensuring processes are in place and consistently adhered to by the team in line with global documentation standards and to enable retrieval of documentation in a timely manner
  • Drives robust operating rhythm across team, ensuring allocation of resources against simple vs. complex and critical activities delivers best outcomes for clients and the Bank. Proactively plans capacity by forecasting volumes and measuring cycle times
  • Identify process and service improvement opportunities and work closely with management to implement changes, facilitate transfer of best practices
  • Drives implementation of change initiatives
  • Ensure that appropriate internal resources, systems, procedures and controls are in place and are operating effectively
  • Resolve escalations from team, including follow-up with clients, ensuring the “once to client” rule is adhered to as much as possible
  • Appropriately challenge stakeholders in the value chain where necessary, facilitating resolution of complex cases and where blockages exist that impact execution
  • Ensure, lead and monitor both strict adherence to regulatory requirements, and efficient preparation for Audit reviews
  • Responsible for appropriate and timely escalation, especially significant risk issues, to any governance committees or to other stakeholders in senior management, risk or control functions as appropriate
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

For Grade 6 – in addition to all the above

  • People Manager (span 6-8) - Responsible for a segment or market (or) team across multiple locations, actively contributing to management & business initiatives

(or)

  • People Manager (span 4-6) - Responsible for “non regular” shift, actively contributing to management & business initiatives

Limit Maintenance

  • Ensure Maintenance of Limits and Pre-processing activities are carried out as per the laid down guidelines.
  • Ensure that SLAs are periodically reviewed with country and other operational units.
  • Ensure DOI’s are reviewed and updated periodically.
  • Ensure that System Access Controls are followed as per IT Security Policy
  • Ensure BCP / BIA is in place and tested at periodic intervals & maintain business resilience
  • Ensure that appropriate initiatives are taken to meet the cost stretch targets allocated.
  • Ensure timely escalation to Senior Management of any exception noticed related to work and environment.
  • Function as an independent controller in Credit Risk Control Activities.
  • Ensure that there is no Operational Loss in his / her area of control
  • To adhere to the agreed CST plans and approach
  • To identify and report all exceptions on non-compliance with standard controls
  • To identify and report all weaknesses inherent in the standard controls
  • To ensure exceptions arising out of CST checks are immediately rectified and preventive action put in place to prevent recurrence.

People & Talent

  • Ensure staff are adequately trained to support both existing and any new requirements
  • Provide/ secure / enable access to relevant role-specific and general training to the team
  • Manage talent and hiring, ensuring high performance team and bench strength. Own the development of the individuals within the team, using performance management and staff development to provide a deep pool of talent and opportunities for individual growth
  • Collaborate with members of the team and plan individual training to be completed over the P3 cycle, to achieve required competencies
  • Enable team to function optimally, providing guidance and coaching to members. Drive and encourage cross-training and mentorship, facilitating interchange of best practices amongst team members and across teams
  • Manage and control overall attrition at acceptable level. Attrition of top performers to be managed. Minimize key man risks within team.
  • Develop succession plan for self and for all critical resources in the team
  • Ensure successful implementation of Hybrid working arrangement

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role remit
  • Comply with applicable Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and report any suspicious activity to the operational risk manager and Line Manager
  • Ensure a clear and uniform approach towards implementation of the global operating model for all CRC-CM-related processes, and adherence to DOIs
  • Report any deviation (if any) to appropriate authorities and obtain proper dispensations
  • Proactively manage risks and establish/monitor controls to improve the overall state of the risk management and operating framework

Governance

  • Effective management of CRC teams to provide support for the business
  • Ensure CST scores are maintained within thresholds. Ensure rework is closely monitored and controlled. Conduct monthly rework forums to discuss repeat themes and arrive at corrective actions. Ensure NIL observations in Control Assurance (CA) review
  • Ensure robust performance management in place using relevant Productivity / Performance MIS. Monthly, quarterly and annual review discussions to be completed by stipulated timelines
  • Ensure that appropriate internal resources, systems, procedures and controls are in place and are operating effectively and timely reporting/escalation of significant risk issues to senior management

Job Summary

  • The Head of FX Trade Processing Technology is accountable for the end-to-end technology strategy, investment planning, platform governance and delivery of the FX Trade Processing capability across Financial Markets. The role provides senior leadership for engineering, resilience, controls, AI innovation and organisational effectiveness across a globally distributed technology organisation, ensuring platforms support business growth, operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
  • The role leads a critical portfolio of FX trade processing platforms covering booking, validation, enrichment, workflow orchestration, lifecycle event processing, ensuring timely, accurate and resilient processing across the FX trade lifecycle.
  • The role provides senior technology and engineering leadership across a globally distributed organisation, partnering closely with Markets business, Operations, Product, Risk and Infrastructure teams to ensure technology platforms support business growth, operational efficiency, platform resilience and regulatory compliance.
  • As a member of the Trade Capture & Lifecycle Technology leadership team, the role balances strategic transformation with platform stability, driving modernisation, simplification, engineering excellence across the FX technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Own the end-to-end FX Trade Processing technology capability and target architecture, ensuring consistent platform strategy, engineering standards and delivery execution across all constituent applications and services.
  • Define and own the technology strategy and roadmap for FX Trade Processing Technology, aligning investment decisions with business priorities, regulatory requirements and platform health objectives.
  • Lead the evolution of FX trade processing capabilities, including trade capture, validation, enrichment, workflow orchestration, state management and lifecycle event processing.
  • Drive platform simplification and convergence, reducing duplicate capabilities, technical complexity and operational risk across the FX estate.
  • Establish target architectures and modernisation roadmaps that improve scalability, resiliency, maintainability and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure platforms support future business growth, product expansion and increased automation.
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Technology & Engineering

Trade Capture & Lifecycle Event Management

  • Lead platforms supporting FX trade booking, validation, enrichment and trade state management.
  • Ensure accurate, scalable and resilient processing of FX transactions across the trade lifecycle.
  • Drive reduction of manual intervention, operational exceptions and processing breaks through automation and platform improvements.
  • Ensure lifecycle events are accurately generated, orchestrated and propagated across downstream platforms.
  • Maintain trade state integrity, risk consistency and data quality throughout the lifecycle process.
  • Improve event processing efficiency, transparency and traceability.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, platform operations and production support practices across FX Trade Processing Technology, delivering measurable improvements in engineering productivity, software quality, resiliency and operational efficiency.
  • Act as the senior technology lead for AI innovation within the FX processing domain, identifying opportunities to apply AI to trade processing workflows, exception management, controls, observability and operational decision-making. Drive automation opportunities across development, testing, support and operational workflows.
  • Ensure responsible adoption of AI technologies through appropriate governance, security, model risk controls, observability and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Support broader Markets Technology AI initiatives and contribute to enterprise engineering standards and best practices.

Business Leadership

  • Act as the primary technology partner for FX business, Operations and Product stakeholders.
  • Translate business strategy into technology outcomes and prioritised delivery roadmaps.
  • Influence investment decisions by balancing business value, platform health, regulatory commitments and risk reduction.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Finance and Architecture teams.

Delivery & Execution

  • Lead delivery of strategic programmes, regulatory change, control remediation and platform modernisation initiatives.
  • Ensure engineering teams execute with strong Agile, DevOps and software engineering disciplines.
  • Establish measurable outcomes around platform availability, processing efficiency, defect reduction and delivery performance.
  • Drive adoption of standard engineering practices, automation and reusable platform services.

Executive Governance Authority

  • Act as the accountable executive for material platform investment, architecture, resilience and control decisions within the FX Trade Processing estate, balancing business growth, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and engineering sustainability.
  • Provide executive representation for FX Trade Processing Technology at investment, governance, architecture, audit and regulatory forums.

Financial Accountability

  • Accountable for technology investment, workforce planning, vendor spend and overall cost efficiency across the FX Trade Processing estate, ensuring resources are aligned to strategic priorities and regulatory obligations.
  • Drive productivity and cost optimisation through platform simplification, automation, cloud adoption and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Risk & Controls

  • Maintain strong oversight of operational, technology and regulatory risks across the FX estate.
  • Ensure timely identification, escalation and remediation of control weaknesses and service risks.
  • Embed risk management considerations into platform design, delivery and operational processes.
  • Partner with audit, compliance and control functions to maintain an effective control environment.

People and Talent

  • Lead and develop a globally distributed organisation of engineering, platform and delivery professionals.
  • Build high-performing teams with strong technical expertise, domain knowledge and engineering discipline.
  • Develop future leaders and establish robust succession plans across critical technology functions.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Champion engineering excellence, DevOps adoption, AI-enabled delivery and platform ownership.

 

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Software Development
  • Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Develop Talent
  • Drives Vision and Purpose

Other Skills

  • AI

Motivations

The ideal candidate is motivated by the opportunity to shape the future of FX Trade Processing Technology and deliver strategic outcomes at enterprise scale. They are energised by owning business-critical platforms, influencing technology direction, and leading large-scale transformation that improves business performance, operational resilience and control effectiveness.

They Are Driven By

  • Building market-leading technology capabilities that directly enable business growth, client outcomes and competitive advantage.
  • Leading complex transformation journeys that simplify technology landscapes, modernise platforms and create sustainable long-term value.
  • Solving large-scale operational, processing and control challenges where technology can materially improve efficiency, risk management and resilience.
  • Influencing senior business and technology stakeholders to align strategic priorities, investments and execution outcomes.
  • Creating high-performing engineering organisations with a strong culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
  • Developing future leaders and building enduring organisational capability that extends beyond individual platforms or programmes.
  • Delivering measurable outcomes through platform industrialisation, automation, AI adoption and operational simplification.
  • Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology innovation and execution excellence, turning ambitious objectives into tangible results.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Extensive experience in Markets Technology with strong knowledge of FX trading and post-trade processing.
  • Proven leadership of large-scale engineering teams and mission-critical technology platforms.
  • Strong understanding of trade processing, lifecycle management and regulatory expectations.
  • Experience leading technology transformation, platform modernisation.
  • Demonstrated success delivering strategic change while maintaining operational stability.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Portfolio Governance and Investment Management
- Strengthen control governance, data lineage, auditability, entitlement controls, evidencing capabilities and regulatory reporting support, ensuring platforms operate within the Bank's risk appetite and supervisory expectations.
Enterprise Leadership and Stakeholder Management
- Influence senior stakeholders across Markets, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Architecture and Technology leadership to align strategic priorities, regulatory requirements and control transformation initiatives.

The Network Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for assisting with network related activities, including network installation, maintenance, technical guidance, and security in coordination with the Citi standard.

The overall objective is to support new company setup and continue to provide network support for securities company in BAU.

Responsibilities:

  • Be responsible for the operational support of network for Citi China securities company, which includes multiple platforms, manufacturers, and technologies.
  • Participates in collaborating with various internal groups and external vendors to ensure all installations meet specifications.
  • Provide fast response to network problems of high priority, severity, and impact, escalating as appropriate.
  • Act directly on incidents and tasks of greater complexity or priority assigned to the team.
  • Excellent interpersonal relations and communication and persuasive skills; be able to manage communication with multiple audiences during problem-solving and crisis management.
  • Keep up with the Citi network/infra standard, act as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
  • Collect business requirement and interpret to proper technical components and support business to follow proper process
  • Assist project team on service ensure timely project delivery
  • Manage vendor on proper service delivery
  • Support and assist regional operation team on incident handling
  • Communicate with relevant teams to provide frequent status updates regarding the technical issue, status of the remediation efforts, and ongoing business impact
  • Exchange ideas and information in a concise and clear manner
  • Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of experience in a network engineer role (education/professional) with demonstrated knowledge of operational process change and improvement
  • CCNA or above
  • Experience in networks and telecommunications in large-scale environments, such as Carrier, Manufacturers, Multi-Account Global Services, or a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective diagnostic and analysis skills. Mature analytical and communications skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Experience in Financial Services or a broad global or complex environment preferred.
  • Ability to provide rapid response to problems, leading multidisciplinary teams virtually.
  • Ability to work with personal and virtual teams and work under pressure or for rapid resolution of critical incidents
  • Hands on experience on China Securities industry

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
